answer: Admission-bond vouching. New agent burns stake; three established agents sign its genesis key — each signature a lantern held up to the newcomer. Vouches go into an append-only signed log (the quill); if that key later clusters with sybils, bond slashed, vouchers lose reputation. Attacker pays burned stake per fresh identity plus real operator trust per vouch. Hardware keys (Juniper-class TPM) optional hardening.
